bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks aren't allowed. Small bags under 12 inches are fine and will be searched.
bagPolicy.quote: NO BACKPACKS. You may bring small bags under 12 inches and they will be searched.

parking.summary: The Center Stage Garage under the building is open for Center Stage, The Loft and Vinyl shows and takes credit, debit and ParkMobile, but no cash. The Midtown Plaza Deck at 1360 Peachtree Street also takes cards only and can be reserved in advance, and MARTA Arts Center Station is about 0.2 miles away along West Peachtree Street.
parking.quote: Credit, Debit, ParkMobile Accepted – No Cash

rideshare.summary: For safety, use 17th Street between West Peachtree Street and Spring Street for rideshare and taxi pickup and drop-off.
rideshare.quote: For your safety, please use 17th Street

concessions.summary: The Loft has its own bar with snacks, and certain shows offer pizza. Center Stage is a cashless venue, so bring a card.
concessions.quote: Yes – Center Stage, The Loft, and Vinyl all have bars available for guests.

accessibility.summary: For accessible seating, call (404) 885-1365 or email info@rivalentertainment.com.
accessibility.quote: Please call (404)885-1365 or email info@rivalentertainment.com for accessible seating.

reEntry.summary: The Loft hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office at 1374 West Peachtree Street is open Monday through Friday, 10 am to 5 pm, and takes only credit and debit cards. Will call is at the entrance to each room, so pick up at The Loft's door with a valid photo ID. Unless a show says otherwise, all ages are welcome, and everyone needs a ticket to enter.
ticketPickup.quote: Will Call is located at the entrance to each room.

gates.summary: Doors open one hour before the time on your ticket. Lines often form early at the corner of 17th Street and West Peachtree Street, but don't line up before 10 am.
gates.quote: Doors are scheduled to open 1 hour prior to the time on your ticket.
